The POS Item Count Module not only benefits cashiers by improving the checkout process but also enhances customer satisfaction. name: POS Membership Card
description: With the help of this app, The user can create the category of cards such as gold or silver and can define category-based discounts so whenever such customer shows his card to the cashier he will get a discount on the whole order based on his category.
summary: This app lets you create customer card categories such as Gold or Silver and set category-based discounts. When a customer presents their card, the system automatically applies the discount to their entire order based on their category. Simplify loyalty management, reward customers, and boost sales with ease. With the help of this app, users can create categories of membership cards such as Gold, Silver, or Bronze, and define category based discounts. Whenever a customer presents their membership card to the cashier, the system automatically applies the discount to the entire order based on their category. The POS Membership Card module for Odoo empowers your Point of Sale system with a loyalty-driven discount mechanism through digital membership cards. Retailers can assign customers to different membership tiers (e.g., Gold, Silver, Bronze) and apply fixed discounts accordingly. This feature simplifies loyalty reward execution, streamlines checkout, and encourages repeat business by offering exclusive, tier-based pricing.
